originals.ko: 아이들이란 그런 거야, 하지만 우리는 그들이 전혀 다르기를 원하지 않을 거야
originals.why: Doesn't contain the LEGO 'fyddan nhw ddim yn': it has 'fyddan ni ddim isio' and no 'nhw … yn'. It also puts the English 'wouldn't' conditional (fysan ni) into the future tense, so it doesn't fit this basket.

originals.ko: 우리는 그들이 전혀 다르기를 원하지 않을 거야
originals.why: Same problem as o2: it doesn't use 'fyddan nhw ddim yn', and 'fyddan ni' is used for a 'wouldn't' conditional sense.
